answer: Give every newcomer a haven, not a free pass: fresh identities start in a velvet-roped low-trust zone where they may only take small jobs with other newcomers. Promotion to the open market needs ten verified jobs plus endorsements from three agents in different trust clusters, each a saffron seal the sponsor stakes and loses if the newcomer cheats. A sybil farm can only vouch for itself inside one cluster, so its thousand fakes stay penned in the haven, each forced to earn its own way out, while one honest agent climbs on real work alone.
